# The attribute types of an Analysis Services server: what the values of an attribute are. One row per type, in the
# order of the enumeration DimensionAttributeTypeEnumType of the Analysis Services Scripting Language.
# name: the type as the schema spells it. number: its place in that enumeration, counted from 0.
# level_type, property_content_type: the codes, hexadecimal, as an Analysis Services server reports them for a level
# (MDSCHEMA_LEVELS.LEVEL_TYPE) and a property (MDSCHEMA_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_CONTENT_TYPE) whose attribute is of the
# type. level_type_spec, property_content_type_spec: the code the specification [MS-SSAS] names, where it names one.
# They differ in two rows, and the server's code is the one taken: FormattingSubtotal (the server reports 0xA1, the
# other_spelling: another spelling a server takes or gives back, which a reader takes as well.
# group: the group of the type, a type of the library of groups beside the server's types; the type is narrower than
# its group. The groups are not the server's: they gather the types by what they describe.
# id: the id of the type in the standard set of the server's types (ServerTypes.SET_URI), a UUID; never changed.
